input: SHCS Superquadra Sul 308 - Asa Sul, Brasília - Federal District, 70390-100, Brazil
note: Brasília is addressed by SECTOR -> QUADRA -> CONJUNTO -> LOT -> BLOCK -> APARTMENT, not by street + house number, and the ComponentTag union has no tag for any rung of it. SHCS = Setor de Habitações Coletivas Sul (the collective-housing sector); Superquadra Sul 308 is the quadra. Neither is asserted here: tagging 'SHCS Superquadra Sul 308' as `street` would encode the very street+number reading this case exists to refute, and `dependent_locality` is already spent on the bairro Asa Sul (the union carries exactly one sub-locality level, so sector-under-bairro is unexpressible). input: SHIS EQL 6/8 Módulo C, Setor de Habitações Individuais Sul, Brasília
note: Official-style CEP logradouro with no street and no number anywhere in it. SHIS = Setor de Habitações Individuais Sul — so the sector is named TWICE in one string, once abbreviated at the head and once expanded at the tail, and the union cannot mark the two mentions as one referent. EQL = Entrequadra Lago, the strip BETWEEN quadras 6 and 8 (the '6/8' is a span of two quadras, not a fraction or a range of house numbers); Módulo C subdivides it. SCHEMA GAP: sector abbreviation/expansion coreference, entrequadra, módulo. No oracle link supplied by the operator — coordinate truth deliberately omitted rather than invented.

input: SHIS QL 6 Conjunto 1, 1009 - bloco 02, apto. 04, Setor de Habitações Individuais Sul, Brasília
note: The full six-rung Brasília hierarchy in one line: sector (SHIS) -> quadra (QL 6) -> conjunto (Conjunto 1) -> lot/building (1009) -> block (bloco 02) -> apartment (apto. 04). Only the last rung has a tag. `1009` is a LOT number inside Conjunto 1, not an ordinal along a street, so `house_number` would be a false positive rather than a near miss. `bloco 02` is a building within the conjunto and shares `unit` with the apartment — Brazilian post treats 'bloco 02, apto. 04' as one two-level complemento, which one `unit` span cannot carry; only the apartment is asserted. SCHEMA GAP: quadra, conjunto, lot, building block. No oracle link supplied — no coordinate asserted.

note: The street really is named 'Avenida Terceira Avenida' — the via type is reduplicated inside the proper name, so a de-duplicating normalizer that drops the leading 'Avenida' silently renames the street. The premises number is DELIBERATELY not asserted: 'Área Especial 2, 02' admits at least three defensible readings — Área Especial 2 as the premises and 02 as a lot inside it, 02 as the premises with Área Especial 2 as a sector qualifier, or the pair as one compound designator.
